title: First-run screen 0.5.1: Linux "Open System Settings" opens GNOME's panel or is hidden; a reopened screen shows the look step as done after a previous Done
steps: S1a: run packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/notify-bridge.test.mjs — on linux with gnome-control-center on PATH the open-settings channel starts `gnome-control-center notifications` and status says settingsTarget true; without it status says false and nothing starts; macOS/Windows open their settings URL.
S1b: run packages/ui/tracy-onboard/test/flow.test.mjs + mount.test.mjs — stepsDone({priorCompleted:true}) marks the look step done; a reopened panel starts at the first step not done.
expect: S2 reports the bundle matches its source.
fence: No change to what a notification says or when it is shown; only where the settings button goes and whether the look step reads Done.
